rule: a row with empty content and non-zero completion tokens is 'empty_content: <cause>', is never graded fail, and is counted missing_answer_empty in the matrix with its cause attached (docs/STOP-REASON.md)

causes_defined.reasoning_only: length cap hit, content empty, reasoning produced — thinking spent the budget
causes_defined.truncated_answer: length cap hit, content NON-empty — a partial answer, graded as an answer
causes_defined.cap_exhausted_no_content: length cap hit, content empty, no reasoning recorded
causes_defined.empty_string_bug: clean finish reason, empty content, no reasoning
causes_defined.unrecorded_empty_content: row carries no finish_reason field; the cause channel was not recorded
causes_defined.zero_tokens_no_content: empty content and zero completion tokens — no generation billed
